metas.description: MBC Studios' first Arabic musical film: Sukkar and her friends in an orphanage dream of transforming their lives into something more meaningful and colourful. Inspired by Jean Webster's 'Daddy-Long-Legs'.
metas.name: سكر

metas.description: A fantasy adventure from MBC Studios, Image Nation and Vox Studios: when a human family moves into Hwjn's house in a world where Jinn must live among humans, Hwjn falls in love with the human daughter Sawsan. Adapted from Ibraheem Abbas' novel.
metas.name: حوجن

metas.description: The Sukkar sequel from MBC Studios: a chickenpox outbreak hits the city and the orphanage; the children search for a cure with a doctor and a magician, while Sukkar tries to save circus animals from cruelty.
metas.name: سكر 2
